baseUrl.description: Base URL for the Mini CMS app.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID used by CLI commands and generated files.

projectId.description: Project ID required for project-scoped pull and push commands, and used by generated clients by default.

apiKey.description: API key used for protected schema and management endpoints.

collectionId.description: Optional collection ID scope for pull, push, or generate.

collectionsPath.description: Path to the collection definitions file or directory.

typesPath.description: Output path for generated TypeScript types.

clientPath.description: Output path for the generated browser client JavaScript file.

declarationsPath.description: Output path for the generated browser client declaration file.
